description: Returns the one person to email at a company: the most senior match for the buyer titles saved on this user's Fundz account whose email address is verified and whose address belongs to that company. It saves reading get_company_contacts and comparing verified, catch-all, invalid and unrevealed addresses by hand. An invalid address is never returned. A catch-all address is returned only when allow_catch_all is true, which is for when the user has said that is acceptable. Anyone this user already contacted, on any lane, is left out and listed separately. Cost: when no verified address is held for the company, this reveals contacts there, which spends one of the user's monthly contact reveals (the result shows how many are left). It does that for at most reveal_budget companies per hour (default 5); beyond that it spends nothing and says so, so the user can decide. Set reveal to false to spend nothing. When nobody verified is found the result says so; that company is best skipped. The result names the person, their title, the address status and why they were chosen, ready to pass to get_smartsend_draft.

allow_catch_all.description: true only after the user said a catch-all address (the domain accepts every address, so the mailbox cannot be confirmed) is acceptable. Default false.

company.description: Company id, slug, domain or name

reveal.description: false to never spend a reveal in this call. Default true.

reveal_budget.description: Most companies to reveal contacts at within one hour, across calls (default 5, max 25). Raise it only when the user asked for a bigger batch.
